sentences.text: This is an application seeking interim suspension of sentence for a period of 60 days on the ground that the ceiling of one of the portion of the house of appellant has broken which is causing extreme hardship to the mother and hence, there is urgent need of repair and re-construction work.
2. The said fact has been verified by the respondent.
It has also been verified that only the old mother of the appellant is staying in the said house.

3. The appellant has been convicted for offences u/s 376(2)(h)/376(2)(n) of IPC and sentenced to 12 years of rigorous imprisonment.
4.

As per the Nominal Roll dated 19.02.2025, the appellant has already spent about 2 years 4 months 10 days, has a remission of 5 months 6 days, leaving an unexpired portion of about 9 years 2 months 14 days.

sentences.text: For the said reasons and in order to repair/reconstruct the broken ceiling of the house, the application is allowed.

The sentence of the appellant is suspended for a period of 30 days from the date of his release with the following terms and conditions:
i.

The appellant shall furnish a personal bond with one local surety in the sum of Rs.
10,000/- each, to the satisfaction of the Jail Superintendent;

ii. The appellant shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer (IO)
concerned, which shall be kept in working condition at all times.
The appellant will furnish his permanent address to the IO and in case he changes his address, he will inform the IO concerned; iv.
The appellant shall not leave the country without permission from the competent Court and if the appellant has a passport, he shall surrender the same to the Jail Superintendent; v.

The appellant shall not communicate with, or come into contact through email, WhatsApp or message with the prosecutrix, or any member of her family;
vi.

The appellant shall not be in the vicinity of the prosecutrix or any of her family members;
vii.
The appellant shall not indulge in any act or omission that is unlawful or that would prejudice the proceedings in pending cases, if any.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 12/03/2025 at 22:30:38 7.
The application is allowed and disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
8. List on 16.05.2025, the date already fixed.
JASMEET SINGH, J MARCH 12, 2025/DM
